summary:
GE航太EPS狂超預期46%，獲利爆發性成長凸顯純航太業務的強大營運槓桿。
• EPS 2.31美元，遠超預期1.58美元，超預期幅度高達46.39%
• 營收127.2億美元，季度規模穩健，售後服務貢獻顯著
• 極大的EPS超預期幅度反映高營運槓桿與利潤率擴張
• 純航太聚焦策略持續釋放獲利潛能
ai_view:
訊號非常強：46%的EPS超預期幅度極為罕見，反映售後服務利潤率與營運槓桿大幅超預期，純航太轉型成效驚人。短期對股價形成強催化，但須提防「預期被一次性墊高」後的後續比較壓力。中期核心在售後服務利潤率與引擎交付節奏。追蹤指標：售後服務營收占比與利潤率、引擎出貨、自由現金流、訂單積壓與管理層指引上修幅度。

需留意：如此大的超預期幅度後，市場對後續季度標準將提高；營收年增率未揭露，須留意成長基期效應；供應鏈瓶頸與航空週期風險仍存

summary_en:
GE Aerospace blew past EPS by 46%, with explosive earnings underscoring strong operating leverage.
• EPS of $2.31 vastly beat the $1.58 estimate, a 46.39% surprise
• Revenue of $12.72B at a solid quarterly scale, with strong aftermarket contribution
• The very large EPS beat reflects high operating leverage and margin expansion
• The pure-aerospace focus strategy keeps unlocking earnings potential

ai_view_en:
Signal is very strong: a 46% EPS beat is rare and reflects aftermarket margins and operating leverage far above expectations, an impressive payoff from the pure-aerospace transition. Near-term a strong catalyst, but beware tougher comparisons after such a one-off-inflated bar. Mid-term the core is aftermarket margins and engine-delivery cadence. Track: aftermarket revenue mix and margins, engine shipments, free cash flow, backlog and the magnitude of guidance raises.

Watch：After such a large beat, the market will raise the bar for subsequent quarters; Revenue YoY not disclosed, so watch base-effect on growth; Supply-chain bottlenecks and air-travel cycle risk persist
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期高達46.39%，獲利爆發性優於預估（營收年增率未揭露）。
